extensionDescription.message: Overlay YouTube live chat and replay comments on videos with flowing or fixed display modes and local DVR synchronization.

timeShiftDescription.message: Replay locally saved live comments at their original playback time

timeShiftPrivacyNotice.message: When enabled, KomeFlow stores video IDs, chat text, message IDs and playback timestamps locally for up to six hours. This data is never sent to the developer or third parties.

timeShiftConsentPrompt.message: Enable DVR time-shift sync? KomeFlow will store video IDs, chat text, message IDs and playback timestamps locally for up to six hours. The data is not sent to the developer or third parties.

clearDataButton.message: Disable DVR and delete saved comments

clearDataError.message: Could not delete saved comments. Please try again.

legalNote.message: YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. KomeFlow is independently developed and is not an official Google LLC or YouTube product.
